name: NetShield
subtitle: SOC Attack & Detection Home Lab
summary: A single-host security console that turns network activity into evidence, investigations and bounded manual response.
highlights: Authenticated operations console with durable alerts, incidents, investigation notes and flow evidence.
25 versioned indicators and 33 offline scenarios; replay and PCAP analysis stay separate from live response authority.
Manual nftables actions use expiry, rollback and kernel readback. Observe-only is the default.

The broader home lab includes isolated Kali, Ubuntu and Metasploitable VMs plus Splunk ingestion and SPL investigations. This is the context around NetShield, not a second project or a claimed Splunk integration.
result: V2 source and operator-recorded Linux VM acceptance are available in the repository. Fresh-install Linux acceptance remains a separate gate.
imageAlt: Supplied NetShield operations console showing network overview and manual-only response

name: E-Banking Security System
subtitle: NeuralGuard · university prototype
summary: A university banking prototype combining transaction monitoring, application security and fraud-model evaluation.
highlights: Evaluated models on 24.4 million transactions; XGBoost reached the CV-reported 94.69% ROC-AUC.
JWT and OTP authentication, role-based access, rate limiting and audit logging.
result: First place at ECU Project Day, December 30, 2025. The reported model score is a dataset evaluation, not a production guarantee.
imageAlt: Supplied NeuralGuard landing-page screenshot for the university E-Banking Security System

name: SHIFAA
subtitle: Graduation project · proposed architecture
role: Product Owner, Team Lead & Architecture Lead
summary: An Egyptian digital-health platform connecting patients, clinics, pharmacies, hospitals and laboratories.
highlights: Leading a six-person team with responsibility for product scope, architecture and delivery coordination.
Public workspace includes role applications, shared packages, services, specifications and Supabase migrations.
result: Ongoing graduation work. The real diagram documents the proposed architecture; it does not imply a production deployment.
imageAlt: Actual proposed SHIFAA architecture: role applications, core API, shared packages, PostgreSQL and isolated services

name: Solar Odyssey
subtitle: Scientific exploration sandbox
summary: A solar-system sandbox with 31 celestial bodies, free-flight exploration, visual layers and a photo mode.
highlights: HDR, bloom, camera-relative rendering and an explicit final sRGB pass.
Camera, settings, gallery and save flows accompany the scientific exploration view.
result: A downloadable Windows release. Educational and stylized; not a precision ephemeris instrument.
imageAlt: Supplied Solar Odyssey main menu with a rendered Earth

name: Al-Tayyibat
subtitle: Arabic food-reference PWA
summary: An Arabic, right-to-left food reference documenting a diet’s rules across 385 food entries.
highlights: Search aliases, filters, source notes, ingredient and recipe details, local favorites and a shopping list.
Offline behavior uses a bounded recent-image cache; no accounts, analytics or backend.
result: A public static PWA with a printable guide. A reference to documented diet rules, not individualized medical advice.
imageAlt: Supplied Al-Tayyibat Arabic interface and food-catalog presentation

name: MEC — MSI EC Control Center
subtitle: msi-ec-tui
summary: A capability-aware Linux terminal interface for supported MSI embedded-controller hardware.
highlights: Seven screens with READY / READ-ONLY compatibility states.
Confirmed hardware changes are validated and read back; profile transactions support rollback.
result: Release archives and Linux packages are published with checksums. Hardware support depends on the detected device and driver.

name: This portfolio
subtitle: Three dimensions, one person
summary: The site you’re exploring: technical, editorial and personal experiences over one source of truth.
highlights: Theme persistence, responsive layouts, keyboard-accessible disclosures and a certificate lightbox.
After Hours loads its scrapbook code and imagery when selected.
result: Three designed experiences over one shared project and credentials system. Prepared for GitHub Pages publication.
